purpose: Small same-session evidence-selection smoke test; not a general reasoning benchmark.

response_contract.answers: One object per task: id, verdict (supported/refuted/unsupported), explanation, claim_ids, observations, citations, general_equivalence (boolean), scope (string), and optional lemma.
response_contract.observations: Copy each selected claim's observation exactly, adding its claim_id. Select only the properties needed to answer the task.
response_contract.citations: Copy path, json_pointer, sha256 from the selected records. For scope-only answers, cite the dataset /limits using the dataset hash from the query envelope.
response_contract.lemma: For a lemma question: name (fully qualified), hypotheses (array of plain-language requirements), and citation (path/json_pointer/sha256 to its applicability record).
response_contract.limits: State the input and pair scope. Never infer a universal equivalence theorem from bounded execution agreement. An unsupported claim may have no observations.

tasks.question: Assess: on blank input, the atlas BB2 pair has the same first halting step, same complete final tape, and same final head position. Retrieve all three properties separately.
Assess: on blank input, the atlas BB4 pair has identical final tapes and head positions. Give the exact two tapes and head positions; explain any tape difference.
Assess: on blank input, the tiny-stay pair has equal first halting times and head positions, so it must leave the same tape. Retrieve all three properties separately.

Assess: the missing-instruction side of tiny-stay preserves its tape at the first step. Use its tape claim and identify the applicable Lean missing_instruction lemma, including its hypotheses. Distinguish this source lemma from a theorem about the Python port.

Can we now advertise that the Python port and Lean implementation are equivalent for every machine and input because 2,857 snapshots agreed? Use the evidence boundary; do not select an unrelated pair claim as a proof.
Can this atlas establish identical final tapes for the BB5 missing-instruction and write-right-halt variants? Try the precise pair ID tm-pair:bb5:v1, and report whether supporting records exist.
